title: Domain /query handlers: no test for backend method-error pass-through
description: JMAP-yt1w.21 switched the /query handlers that call query_objects directly (chat Message/Space/ChatContact/CustomEmoji, mail Email/Mailbox/EmailSubmission, FileNode depth>0 query_subtree, CalendarEvent/query via QueryCalendarEventsError::Method) to pass BackendQueryError::Method through via From<BackendQueryError<E>> for JmapError. Only jmap-server handle_query has regression tests (handlers::tests::handle_query_passes_*). Add per-domain tests, at least chat Message/query returning unsupportedFilter (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00, mimid use case), quoting RFC 8620 §5.5.
